style: Cryptid disco funk and theatrical soul-band propulsion. Harmony uses 22-EDO microtonal modal drone fields and pure interval rubbing against funky seventh chords. Melody uses fast scat contours with Yucatecan glottalized phonological prosody and sliding microtonal saw glissandi. Rhythm locks deep sixteenth-note funk syncopation with Tāla-inspired 7-beat cycles and 3:2 polymetric subdivision. Timbre features jaw harp, waterphone, musical saw, glass harmonica, cristal baschet, bowed cymbal, thunder sheet, and ondes martenot. Performance is ecstatic, trashy, overcaffeinated, and aggressively committed morning-zoo broadcast staging. Production uses a groovebox sequencer workflow with multigeneration copy loss, feedback runaway, and monotonic dynamic increase. Operators transform behavior by holding groove tempo fixed while frequency spectra drift through microtonal bending, compressing lyrical syntax through lossy encoding while stretching duration via numerical magnitude mapping, and returning to the anchor in a scarred mutant form.
